note: Apps Bank. Order of preference for any feature: (1) native Shopify / theme feature, (2) free app made by Shopify, (3) VSN app, (4) third-party app only if 1-3 cannot do it (record why). Never remove or hide an option Shopify provides. 'theme_integration' = what the theme must support so the app works out of the box; every app with theme_integration must appear in a design spec's app_map.

source.title: Shopify Help Center: Apps made by Shopify
source.pricing_note: Shopify says its apps are usually free; confirm each app's price on its App Store page before relying on it.

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Search & Discovery
shopify_apps.use: filters, search synonyms, product recommendations, complementary products
shopify_apps.theme_integration: faceted filters on collection + search, predictive search, related + complementary product sections

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Forms
shopify_apps.use: email signup / popups, early access lists
shopify_apps.theme_integration: app embed + app block slots in newsletter, drop-release and password sections

shopify_apps.name: Translate & Adapt
shopify_apps.use: translations for products, pages, theme content
shopify_apps.theme_integration: all strings in locales, every setting translatable, language selector

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Bundles
shopify_apps.theme_integration: bundle-aware price, cart line components display

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Subscriptions
shopify_apps.theme_integration: selling plan picker on product, selling plan info in cart

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Inbox
shopify_apps.theme_integration: app embed allowed; chat button must not overlap sticky add to cart on mobile

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Messaging
shopify_apps.theme_integration: newsletter forms tag customers (accepts_marketing)

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Flow
shopify_apps.use: automation (e.g. tag early-access customers, hide sold-out drops)
shopify_apps.theme_integration: theme reads customer tags and product tags/metafields that Flow sets

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Collabs
shopify_apps.theme_integration: none required; UGC strip can feature creators

shopify_apps.name: Shop Channel
shopify_apps.use: Shop app presence, Follow on Shop
shopify_apps.theme_integration: Follow on Shop button (login_button), Shop Pay buttons

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Audiences
shopify_apps.theme_integration: none (keep content_for_header untouched)

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Combined Listings
shopify_apps.theme_integration: combined-listing swatches on product card and product page

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Checkout Blocks
shopify_apps.theme_integration: match brand colors/logo in checkout settings guide

shopify_apps.name: Launchpad
shopify_apps.theme_integration: drop-release and password sections work with scheduled theme/collection changes

shopify_apps.name: Digital Products
shopify_apps.theme_integration: no shipping text for digital items in product + cart

shopify_apps.name: Shopcodes
shopify_apps.theme_integration: none

shopify_apps.name: Shopify POS
shopify_apps.theme_integration: pickup availability block, store info section

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Knowledge Base
shopify_apps.use: FAQs used by AI shopping agents
shopify_apps.theme_integration: FAQ section with structured data

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Marketplace Connect
shopify_apps.theme_integration: none

shopify_apps.name: Shopify Order Printer
shopify_apps.theme_integration: none

vsn_apps.name: VSN | Product Types
vsn_apps.use: variant cards, swatches, variant fields, custom buttons, cart drawer and live preview (from the VSN Figma app listing)
vsn_apps.theme_integration: app block slots in main-product and featured-product, cart drawer hook, swatch styling tokens
vsn_apps.status: confirm feature list with the VSN team

vsn_apps.name: VSN | Stock Down Sort
vsn_apps.use: push sold-out products to the end of collections
vsn_apps.theme_integration: collection grid respects app sort order; hide-sold-out toggle stays compatible
vsn_apps.status: confirm feature list with the VSN team

vsn_apps.name: VSN | Metafields
vsn_apps.use: manage metafields/metaobjects (fit info, size charts, specs)
vsn_apps.theme_integration: dynamic sources for fit-info, size-chart, specs and badge blocks
vsn_apps.status: confirm feature list with the VSN team
